title: Normalization of Sample Concentrations in Deepwell Plates
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Calculate and add diluent
steps.instruction: Calculate the required diluent volume for each well (using the uploaded .json parameters) and add it to all wells of the deep‑well plate; if a two‑step dilution is needed, keep the total volume ≤ 1600 µL and let the protocol dynamically choose the most efficient pipette (P300 multi‑channel or P1000 single‑channel). The method supports up to 32 samples.

substeps.instruction: Compute diluent volume per well based on target concentration and sample volume.
Dispense the calculated diluent into every well of the deep‑well plate, respecting the 1600 µL maximum.

steps.title: Add samples to dilution plate 1
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and add the first column of samples to dilution plate 1 using the user‑specified sample volume.

steps.title: Mix diluted samples
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, mix each column in dilution plate 1 by aspirating/dispensing at the bottom of the well and again halfway up the liquid to ensure homogeneity; the liquid‑level is automatically calculated to keep the tip submerged.

substeps.instruction: Mix at the bottom of each well.
Mix halfway up the liquid column.

steps.title: Transfer to final dilution plate (if needed)
steps.instruction: If a second dilution is required, transfer the mixed sample from dilution plate 1 to the corresponding column of dilution plate 3, which already contains the pre‑added diluent from step 1, to achieve the final dilution.
